summary: fix(admin-panel): match relying party filter case-insensitively
description:
## Because

- The relying party filter in the admin panel compared the text with `indexOf`, so it was case-sensitive. Typing `send` did not find `Send`.
- The filter trimmed the text only for the empty check. Input with leading or trailing spaces matched nothing.

## This pull request

- Updates `getFilteredRps` in `PageRelyingParties/index.tsx` to trim and lowercase the filter text once.
- Compares that text with `includes` against the lowercased name and the lowercased ID.
- Adds a test in `PageRelyingParties/index.test.tsx` that types `  firefox SEND ` and then an upper-cased ID.
- Removes the "case-sensitive includes" wording from a comment in the existing filter test.

## Issue that this pull request solves

Closes:
